name: smith rear delt row
description: A bent-over rear-delt row using the Smith bar. Pull the bar toward the upper chest while keeping the elbows wide.
instructions: Set the Smith bar low, stand facing it, and grip the bar wider than shoulder width.
Hinge at the hips with soft knees and a neutral back so your torso is inclined forward.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest with elbows moving out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades briefly, then lower the bar along the rails under control.
